scripts.initial: pnpm exec lefthook install && pnpm install && pnpm install:templates
scripts.install:templates: pnpm --dir template/next/app/tailwind install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir template/next/app/vanilla-extract install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir template/next/pages/tailwind install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir template/next/pages/vanilla-extract install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir template/tanstack-router/tailwind install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir template/tanstack-router/vanilla-extract install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build:only: pnpm exec vite build && node scripts/write/bin-write.mts
scripts.build: pnpm cp:frontend-template:bin && pnpm exec vite build && node scripts/write/bin-write.mts
scripts.build:release: pnpm cp:frontend-template:bin && pnpm exec vite build && node scripts/write/bin-write.mts && pnpm format && pnpm lint:fix
scripts.lint:check: pnpm exec oxlint . --ignore-pattern "template/**" && pnpm --dir template/next/app/tailwind exec oxlint . --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/next/app/vanilla-extract exec oxlint . --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/next/pages/tailwind exec oxlint . --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/next/pages/vanilla-extract exec oxlint . --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/tanstack-router/tailwind exec oxlint . --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/tanstack-router/vanilla-extract exec oxlint . --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-pattern "template/**" && pnpm --dir template/next/app/tailwind exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/next/app/vanilla-extract exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/next/pages/tailwind exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/next/pages/vanilla-extract exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/tanstack-router/tailwind exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore && pnpm --dir template/tanstack-router/vanilla-extract exec oxlint . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && cd test/auto && UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.tmp/uv uv sync && UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.tmp/uv uv run main.py
